channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Crashes on CO Interstate Leave Five Dead
item.description: Five people died in a multi-vehicle crash on Interstate 25 in Colorado due to low visibility from blowing dirt caused by strong winds. The investigation into the cause is ongoing.

item.title: IN Fire Chief Removed
item.description: Mike Weitzel has been removed as Portland's fire chief. Chuck Denney is expected to succeed him, pending confirmation.

item.title: Gas Explosion Kills 16 After Apartment Building Partially Collapses in Pakistan
item.description: A gas explosion in Karachi killed at least 16 people, prompting calls for improved building safety and gas cylinder regulations in Pakistan.

item.title: Workers Rescued After Scaffolding Collapses at CA High-Rise
item.description: Two workers were rescued after their scaffolding collapsed at an eight-story building in Sacramento.

item.title: Explosion Tears Through MI Business
item.description: Firefighters responded to a building explosion at EFI Inc. in Ypsilanti Township. Details on injuries and the cause of the blast are currently unavailable.

item.title: Video: NC Home Had Flames Shooting Through Roof in Middle of the Night
item.description: A fire erupted at a two-story home near Myers Park Country Club, with flames visible from the roof. Firefighters controlled the fire in 36 minutes.

item.title: Lithium-Ion Batteries Cause Fire at WA Glass Shop
item.description: A fire at a Spokane Valley automotive glass shop was caused by charging lithium-ion batteries.

item.title: MA Bridge Burns in Homeless Encampment Fire
item.description: A fire in a homeless encampment under Lawrence's Central Bridge caused significant damage.

item.title: Heavy Snow Caused Gas Leak, Explosion at NY Church that Injured Firefighters
item.description: An explosion at the Abundant Life Fellowship Church in Boonville was caused by a damaged propane line.
